# CyberCat

> CyberCat is an Australian cybersecurity awareness and digital wellbeing initiative that helps people recognise scams, social engineering, unsafe digital behaviour and human-factor cybersecurity risks.

CyberCat uses characters, storytelling and practical behavioural techniques to make cybersecurity understandable and relevant to individuals, businesses and vulnerable communities.

Official website: https://cybercat.au/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cybercat.au/): Introduction to CyberCat and its cybersecurity awareness mission.
